findings: `article.formation.type` is `disputed`, but the prose describes distinct proposed constructions without clearly identifying why the competing early analyses cannot be resolved; clarify the disagreement between early 步 + 戉 and borrowing from 戉, while keeping the later 步 + 戌 seal-script account separate. The existing evidence supports this distinction (X-2610486b94cb1f87b36c, X-93fff2c45a15520b90d0, X-e59a57e510af5b554b5f).

`article.meaning_history.senses[0].certainty` is `probable`, yet its claim is specifically that paleographic accounts report oracle-bone use for “year.” That reported usage is documented in the cited evidence; retain the qualification that the primary inscriptions were not independently checked, but set certainty to `established` for the reported historical use (X-2610486b94cb1f87b36c, X-521fe52a705865027539, X-93fff2c45a15520b90d0).
